content: Customer Dev Chatterjee requested written confirmation regarding the expiration of his current travel policy on 30/09/2026 and inquired about purchasing a new policy for next year with existing customer discounts. Insurance agent Anita Sharma confirmed the policy expiration, provided a PDF summary of the status, and offered a 5% loyalty discount for a new policy starting 01/10/2027, asking for specific travel dates or a quote confirmation.
